engineeringSkip.reason: Manipulating nucleon interiors to alter physical constants or warp space-time has no basis in known physics and no real research programme behind it.

factCheck.reason: Femtotech lattices describe rearranging the insides of protons and neutrons to give matter 'custom physical constants' and warp space-time — rearranging nucleons is not something any known process can do, and the constants of physics are not tunable material properties.
